en: First Stable release, promoting the application code from Beta 2026.1104.16581 without adding new application features. Includes local and Doubao recognition, optional AI polishing, and the continuous-paste fix.
Stable builds use the Stable update channel by default. Labs features remain experimental and opt-in; existing user preferences are preserved.
zh-Hans: 将 Beta 2026.1104.16581 的应用代码提升为首个 Stable 正式版，不加入新应用功能。包含本地和豆包识别、可选 AI 润色及连续粘贴修复。
正式版默认使用 Stable 更新通道，实验室功能仍为实验性且按需开启；已有用户偏好保持不变。
